content_sections.heading: CUH Faculty Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Vacancy details are category-wise as released in the official notifications. If no eligible EWS candidate is found, the post will be treated as Unreserved (UR). *If no eligible EWS candidate is found, the post will be considered as UR. The University reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of posts.

content_sections.heading: CUH Faculty Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility is as per the UGC Regulations on Minimum Qualifications for Appointment of Teachers and other Academic Staff in Universities and Colleges and Measures for the Maintenance of Standards in Higher Education, 2018 (as amended from time to time) and AICTE / NCTE / PCI norms wherever applicable. Applicants must possess the prescribed qualifications and experience as on the closing date of application (31 August 2026). Detailed qualifications are available on the official UGC / AICTE / NCTE / PCI websites and the University website.

content_sections.heading: CUH Faculty Salary/ Pay Scale
content_sections.text: All posts carry UGC pay scales plus admissible allowances. Selected candidates will be governed by the New Pension Scheme of the Government of India as extended by the UGC.

content_sections.heading: CUH Faculty Selection Process
content_sections.text: The University may assess teaching and/or research aptitude through a seminar, lecture or discussion on the use of latest technology at the interview stage. Assessment is based on evidence such as publications, project sanction letters, utilization certificates, patent acknowledgements and Ph.D. award letters. Mere fulfilment of minimum qualifications does not guarantee a call for interview. The University may restrict the number of candidates called for interview on the recommendations of the shortlisting/screening committee.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CUH Faculty Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website of Central University of Haryana - www.cuh.ac.in . Fill the online application form available on the University website within the prescribed time limit. Pay the application fee online (if applicable). Submit separate applications and pay separate fees for each post/department applied for. Upload required documents (caste certificate, PwBD certificate, Ph.D. compliance certificate, equivalence certificate for foreign degrees, etc.) in the prescribed format. No addition or modification will be allowed after submission of the application form. The last date for submission of online applications is 31 August 2026, 11:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of caste certificate and/or medical certificate (for PwBD) in the format prescribed by the Government of India. Ph.D. degree compliance certificate in the prescribed format (Annexure I & II) for Assistant Professor applicants (as applicable). Equivalence Certificate from the Association of Indian Universities, New Delhi (for Ph.D. degrees from foreign universities). No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer (for candidates serving in Government / Public Sector Undertakings / Autonomous Bodies) at the time of interview. Any other documents supporting eligibility, experience and claims made in the application. Incomplete applications or applications without required documents will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates looking for more teaching and faculty opportunities can also explore the latest Haryana Government Jobs and Central University Jobs across India. Those interested in research and academic positions may check Teaching Government Jobs matching their qualifications. Applicants searching for openings in the region can also browse Faridabad Government Jobs and other nearby opportunities.

faq.question: Q1. What is CUH Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: What is CUH Faculty Recruitment 2026? Central University of Haryana has invited online applications for Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts under Advertisement Nos. CUH/03/R/T/2026 and CUH/02/R/T/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CUH Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for filling the online application is 31 August 2026, 11:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in CUH Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Vacancies are available across multiple departments as detailed in the vacancy tables above. The exact number is category-wise and the University may increase or decrease the posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for CUH Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: UR/OBC/EWS candidates need to pay Rs 1,000 (non-refundable). SC, ST, PwBD and Women candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale for CUH Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor - Level 10, Associate Professor - Level 13A, Professor - Level 14 (as per 7th Pay Commission) plus admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for CUH Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online only through the official website of Central University of Haryana (www.cuh.ac.in). Separate applications are required for each post/department.
